These Sidereal and Firmamental Infections are known and cured by the Adept physician Firmamentally: for the medicine is Adept. It is the Art which gives the knowledge of how to know and expel Firmamental Infections.

The Magnet of Man. Magical cure, in which is the celestial impression after contact with an herb; until the herb has putrefied, it attracts the medicine into the ulcer, and thus heals it.

plainly, the greatest part of diseases coming from Celestial Influence and from the Astral Impression of the Firmament of the Greater world does not desire to be cured by indiscriminate Remedies, such as the Arcana of herbs, minerals, or metals, but rather the cure must be instituted through Astronomical Influence with those things, at least, that have an Analogy to the greater and lesser worlds. In these is the true Magnetic power of the Firmament and the Celestial Impression of resisting diseases from the Firmament of the greater and lesser worlds, as appears in Persicaria <gloss>smartweed</gloss>, greater Solidago <gloss>comfrey</gloss>, Dracunculus <gloss>dragonwort</gloss>, and greater Symphytum <gloss>comfrey</gloss>.

If a disease or pain is inflicted Supernaturally through incantation or the Magical Impression of the Ascendants, the attempt to heal using the former three is useless, but according to Paracelsus, one must proceed Magically and Supernaturally, and the evil must be repelled in turn in the same way it was inflicted. Otherwise, in the stated Simples there is an Influential attractant, and all things, by Divine ordination, cure Magically, Astronomically, and Magnetically, because the medicine is in them and in Man there is a Magnet.
